afterImage.name: Caturus
afterImage.subsector: Integrated natural gas and LNG platform
afterImage.description: Caturus is an integrated U.S. natural-gas and LNG platform whose legal parent is Caturus Holdco, LLC, renamed from SoTex HoldCo in August 2025. The platform combines Caturus Energy's Texas upstream production with the controlled 9.5 mtpa Commonwealth LNG export project in Cameron Parish, Louisiana. After the May 14, 2026 CPP Investments closing, regulatory filings support a direct governance cap table of 52.6% Kimmeridge-managed interests, 24.1% Mubadala, 22.8% CPP Investments and 0.5% Caturus management. CPP also has a disclosed economic look-through through Kimmeridge-managed funds, but that indirect interest carries no additional governance and public CPP percentages use a different aggregation basis; the 22.8% direct interest is therefore used for the ownership row. Kimmeridge's exact fund allocation and CPP's primary-versus-secondary mix are not publicly disclosed. Caturus reported more than 1 Bcfe per day of net production across approximately 280,000 net acres after the Galvan Ranch acquisition, while Commonwealth LNG reached FID and closed project financing in May 2026. Caturus Energy and Commonwealth LNG are subordinate operating subsidiaries/projects, not separate manager-level PortCos, and project financiers are not parent owners. No later platform sale, owner exit, cancellation or signed pending ownership transfer was identified through August 19, 2026.
